notes: Primary constructor - reads one Vorbis codebook header from the shared bit reader (VorbisAudioDecoder.method2789/readBits, method2788/readBit): 24-bit sync pattern (discarded), 16-bit dimension into anInt4514, 24-bit entry count into anInt4518, then codeword lengths (anIntArray4516) either as an 'ordered' run-length list (bool flag) or a flat per-entry list (with an optional 'sparse/unused entries' flag bool_23_) - matches the real libvorbis codebook header layout (sync/dimensions/entries/ordered-flag/codeword-lengths) almost exactly. Calls method3579/buildDecodeTree to construct the Huffman decode table, then if a VQ lookup type (readBits(4)) is nonzero, reads minValue/deltaValue via VorbisAudioDecoder.method2786/float32Unpack, valueBits, a sequence-flag, computes the multiplicand count via method3580 (lookupType==1) or dimension*entries (lookupType==2), reads the multiplicands into anIntArray4517, and finally expands them into the per-entry value vectors aFloatArrayArray4515 (VQ lookup table) - again matching libvorbis's codebook lookup-table construction (maptype 1 vs 2) almost line for line.

Private. Builds the canonical-Huffman decode jump table anIntArray4519 from the codeword lengths anIntArray4516, using a temporary per-length 'next available code' table (is_0_/is) - a fixed-point reimplementation of libvorbis's codebook decode-tree construction (assigning canonical codewords by length, then building a binary jump table where negative entries are leaf pointers to the codebook entry index and positive entries are jump offsets). Not independently re-derived bit-for-bit, but the overall algorithm (canonical Huffman code assignment + binary tree flattening into an int array) is a confident structural match to the real algorithm this class is a port of.

Walks the anIntArray4519 Huffman decode tree one bit at a time via VorbisAudioDecoder.method2788/readBit (tree-navigate while entries are non-negative/non-leaf), returning the decoded codebook entry index (bitwise-inverted leaf values are stored as negative, hence the final `.inv()`). Matches real libvorbis's vorbis_book_decode. Called by VorbisFloorDecoder.method1534/decodeFloor1 via VorbisAudioDecoder.aVorbisCodebookArray6718 to decode floor-curve class/subclass indices.

Returns the VQ lookup value-vector aFloatArrayArray4515 for the entry decoded by decodeCodeword() - i.e. 'read one Huffman-coded VQ codeword off the bitstream and return its associated float vector', matching libvorbis's vorbis_book_decodevs-style codebook value lookup.

Companion, private. `entries^(1/dim)` rounded, then decremented while `intPow(dim, candidate) > entries` (via ByteBufferStatics.method3331) - an exact structural match to libvorbis's `_book_maptype1_quantvals` helper, which computes how many distinct quantization values are needed per dimension for VQ lookup-table maptype 1. Only call site: this class's own init block, when lookupType==1.
